title: 东西配殿 Dong Xi peidian
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: The formal entrance of the garden as it stood in the 1850s, from the terrace before 大宫门 to the rock peaks behind the audience hall: the plan S01 gives the layout, the yellow slip 样001-4 the hall's seven bays, depth and porches (A), Malone and Barrow its platform (B), the dig the gate's base (B), the leaf of 1744 the roofs, colours, railings and the gallery, the witnesses of 1860 the flagged courts, the marble canal and bridge, the lions. Heights, the halls round the courts and every ornament are C.
rows: Layout

As S01 draws it (re-read in Round 19 in plan pixels, B): 大宫门 on the palace wall, the inner court with its offices and ranges, the moon-shaped canal, 出入贤良门 on the gate line, the court and 正大光明殿 with its terrace; S01 draws the hall and terrace 0.8 times the stated sizes (Q256), the model keeps the stated sizes centred where S01 draws them
正大光明殿

Seven bays 4.32 + 4.32 + 4.83 + 5.17 + 4.83 + 4.32 + 4.32 m with porches of 1.92 m all round, 16.0 m deep (the slip 样001-4, A); the rear porch walled in, the front end bays windows over a sill wall, the rear end bays walled (the slip, A; Barrow, B); ten red columns across the front (Malone, B); the platform 39.3 x 19.2 m, 1.22 m above the court (Malone, Barrow, B); three flights (Malone; the leaf); rolled 歇山, grey tile, a painted bracket band (the leaf, S337, Barrow, B); column 5.12 m and the roof's pitch C; Yongzheng's plaque 正大光明 (S05, A)
Terrace 月台
38.40 x 14.82 m, 0.26 m high, with four censers (S119, B; added 1775-1793); the balustrade and the censers' form C
Court

Flagged (Wolseley, M'Ghee 1860, B), 79 x 22.6 m between the side halls and from the terrace to the gate line (S01); the five-bay side halls 东西配殿 (S05, A; their form C); a covered way east from the hall (the leaf, Malone, B); the rock peaks of 寿山 behind (S05, the leaf; places and heights C)
出入贤良门

Five bays (S05, A), rolled 歇山 (S337, B), red plank doors in the middle bays (the leaf); the duty rooms either side, lower and gabled (S05, the leaf); the gate line's rubble wall about 4 m high with two side gates (Varin 1860, the leaf, S05; B); widths and heights C
Canal and bridge

The moon-shaped canal about 3 m wide lined with white marble (S05, S01, Varin; B), red railings on its banks (the leaf); one flat marble bridge on the axis, its north end flared (S01; levelled flat in 1839, S211, A), wooden railings and two gilt dragons (Varin, B; their form C); a slab crossing where S01 breaks the canal east of the axis (C). S05 gives three bridges (Q130)
Inner court

Flagged (M'Ghee 1860, B); the court offices 内朝房, five bays each (S05, A; form C); a long range on each side (S01; the east one has no box, C); the garden wall round it, red (Round 19's W01 on S01; colour and height C)
大宫门

Five bays (S05, A) on the dig's base 21.57 x 11.33 m, 0.77 m high (S102, B); rolled 歇山 (S337, B); red plank doors with gilt studs (Wolseley 1860, B); Yongzheng's plaque 圆明园 (S05, A); the column 4.16 m and the brackets C; on the palace wall (S42) with a 左门 either side (S42, S01; form C)
Terrace and lions
The gate's terrace as S01 draws it (21.6 x 10 m; height 0.40 m C) with a pair of bronze lions on stone pedestals where S01 draws two squares (1763, S42; Wolseley, Varin 1860; B); the lions' form C
Before the gate
The court offices 外朝房, five bays each (S05, A; at S01's boxes; form C); the stone road on the axis 4.8 m wide (S05, S42, S01; B)
Beyond the model
勤政殿 of 勤政亲贤 (YM02-01) and the spirit wall 大影壁 (YM41-12) are models of their own, drawn by this model's generator
Assumed

Every height but the platforms', the halls round the courts, the ranges and duty rooms, the side gates, the censers, the lions' and dragons' form, the balustrade, the brackets, the rock peaks: the hall kit's classes and the Qing manual's typology (C, the pale tint with conf=1)

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 正大光明
evidence.excerpt_zh: 大宫門内為出入賢良門五楹門左右為直房前跨石橋度橋東西朝房各五楹西南為茶膳房再西為繙書房東南為清茶房為軍機處（圓明園冊）臣等謹按出入賢良門額世宗御書是為二宫門凡武職侍衛引見御此門較射左右直房為各部院臣工入直之所東西設兩罩門各衙門奏事由東罩門逓進茶膳房太監人等由西罩門出入門前河形如月中駕石橋三其水自西來東注如意門閘口㑹東園各河而出出入賢良門内為正大光明殿七楹東西配殿各五楹後為壽山殿東為洞明堂（圓明園冊）臣等謹按圓明園四十景中世宗御題四字額者凡十有四正大光明殿其一也餘如牡丹臺今為鏤月開雲蓬萊洲今為蓬島瑶臺乃乾隆九年皇上恭依避暑山莊三十六景四字題額之例更鍚嘉名用昭畫一敬就各條下加按並恭載御製四十景詩至附近各景詩已載御製詩全集者兹不備録又按正大光明殿内聨曰心天之心而宵衣旰食樂民之樂以和性怡情為世宗御書又聨曰遹求寜觀成無逺弗届以對時育物有那其居為皇上御書東壁懸御書周書無逸篇西壁懸豳風圖東為洞明堂世宗御書額
evidence.summary: Through the five-bay 出入賢良門, the second gate with duty rooms and three stone bridges over a moon-shaped canal, are court offices, kitchens, the translation office and the 軍機處 Grand Council. Then 正大光明殿 of seven bays with five-bay side halls, 壽山殿 behind and 洞明堂 to the east. The notes explain the renaming of the fourteen Yongzheng titles under the 1744 four-character scheme, and record the couplets, the 無逸 text on the east wall and the 豳風 picture on the west wall.

evidence.title: 圆明园正大光明初探
evidence.summary: The whole front court district, built 1725, 370 x 310 m. 大宫门 and 出入贤良门 are five-bay gate halls with 卷棚歇山 roofs on the garden's south wall line. 正大光明殿: seven bays by three, all-round gallery, single eave, grey tile, high base, 36.45 x 16 m, with a terrace and four incense burners. Stresses its garden-like, less formal planning.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
